title: Reviewer 0.29 same-volume cold recovery of active CardputerDict ADV playback

execution.environment: macOS system Python 3.9.6 and authenticated Virtio VSOCK to a no-NIC Linux VM

checks.detail: Same authenticated loopback address across boots, HTTP 401 and 403 scope controls
Expected HTTP 409 and one fenced lease; preserved Flash and old PCAP
Controller acknowledged old-VM stop and supplied protected receipt; old lease, working Flash and Reviewer intent released
Same-original standard retry HTTP 202 then SIM_VERIFIED, 10605-byte SD MP3, 84992-byte I2S PCM, paired ZIP and direct API payload matches
Both owned VMs, reviewers and relays stopped; zero active leases
Production Reviewer still uses current native worker; dedicated resident Linux controller outside this rehearsal
No real hardware or host hard-loss experiment

notes: Exact Reviewer 0.29 package and source hashes verified on Mac host; Device app and API unchanged from c9.
Prior 0.28 record is preserved. This repin passed on the first isolated two-boot trial. Burner not submitted.
